verdict.rationale: Obsidian's own docs describe extending the app with community-built plugins that add features such as extra file formats and third-party integrations. Restricted Mode is on by default to block third-party code, which implies an opt-in install path. Community users corroborate a working ecosystem by naming specific third-party plugins (Dataview, Text-Generator, Git, a CRDT collaboration plugin) that fill gaps in the core app. Missing for 10: an explicit description of the in-app browse/install flow, and documented evidence of the catalog's size.
